name: ges-live-system-preview
description: Source lives in src/ (data.js, canvas.js, app.js, index.template.html). Run `npm run build` to compile it all into a single self-contained index.html at the repo root, with styles.css and the app bundle inlined directly into it - that ONE file is the entire deployable site, download its raw contents from GitHub and drop it straight into WordPress, no other files needed. app.js/styles.css are also still written at the repo root as intermediate build artifacts (useful for diffing changes), but nothing needs to be uploaded alongside index.html anymore. Never hand-edit the root index.html or app.js directly; edit src/ and rebuild.

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --outfile=app.js --loader:.js=jsx --jsx-factory=React.createElement --jsx-fragment=React.Fragment --banner:js="// Built from src/ via npm run build - do not edit this file directly." && node scripts/build-html.js
